title: Level 4 (Expert) - C-9
notes:
West leads the ♣Q against 6♣. West's trump lead should be won by South. The opening lead reveals a trump loser. It looks like South has a choice of either finessing in spades or in hearts. A successful finesse in either suit will see the contract home while a losing finesse will leave the contract with no hope.

By using elimination technique, South can improve his chances and make the contract if either finesse works. South should cash his other top club honour followed by the ♠A. South next plays his diamonds. If West refuses to ruff, he will be thrown in with his trump trick. If West has the ♠K, he will be endplayed. A spade play will set up dummy's ♠Q for a heart discard. A heart return will also solve South's problems.

If East has the ♠K, West can return a spade without cost. Dummy's ♠Q is covered by the ♠K and ruffed by South. Dummy can be entered in trump and South can try the heart finesse.
